classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: An individual flight (arrival or departure leg) tracked through the Airport CDM Platform from flight-plan activation to take off.

attributes.name: flightId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the flight.

attributes.name: callSign
attributes.description: Aircraft call sign.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: Registration of the aircraft, confirmed via the flight plan before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: Type of aircraft, which may be updated by the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: ICAO code of the departure aerodrome (ADEP).

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: ICAO code of the destination aerodrome.

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: Estimated Off-Block Time, normally known 3 hours in advance and shared by ATC, Network Operations and Stand/Gate Management.

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: Scheduled Off-Block Time fed to Network Operations before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: tobt
attributes.description: Target Off-Block Time provided/updated by the Aircraft Operator/Ground Handler at successive milestones.

attributes.name: tsat
attributes.description: Target Start Up Approval Time issued by ATC (Milestone 10).

attributes.name: ctot
attributes.description: Calculated Take Off Time issued by Network Operations for regulated flights at EOBT-2hr.

attributes.name: etot
attributes.description: Estimated Take Off Time, updated for a departure upon flight plan activation.

attributes.name: ttot
attributes.description: Target Take Off Time, calculated from EIBT+MTTT+EXOT or TOBT+EXOT and updated at multiple milestones.

attributes.name: atot
attributes.description: Actual Take Off Time recorded when the aircraft takes off (Milestone 3 outstation / Milestone 16 destination).

attributes.name: eldt
attributes.description: Estimated Landing Time, updated for an arrival on flight plan activation and refined via FUM, radar and final approach detection.

attributes.name: eibt
attributes.description: Estimated In-Block Time, computed from ELDT plus estimated taxi-in time (EXIT).

attributes.name: aldt
attributes.description: Actual Landing Time, recorded at touch-down with +/-1 minute accuracy.

attributes.name: aibt
attributes.description: Actual In-Block Time, recorded when the aircraft arrives in-blocks.

attributes.name: acgt
attributes.description: Actual Commence of Ground Handling Time, considered to start at AIBT for normal turn-rounds.

attributes.name: ardt
attributes.description: Actual Ready Time - doors closed, bridge removed, ready to taxi immediately upon TWR instruction.

attributes.name: asrt
attributes.description: Actual Start-up Request Time, when the pilot requests start up via ATC.

attributes.name: asat
attributes.description: Actual Start-up Approval Time received from ATC.

attributes.name: aobt
attributes.description: Actual Off-Block Time when the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position.

attributes.name: exot
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-Out Time calculated by ATC based on traffic load, gate/stand, runway in use and holding position wait.

attributes.name: exit
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-In Time used with ALDT/ELDT to compute EIBT.

attributes.name: mttt
attributes.description: Minimum Turn-Round Time used, with EXOT, to derive TTOT from EIBT.

attributes.name: estimatedElapsedTime
attributes.description: Estimated elapsed time from the FPL, used with ATOT from outstation to calculate ELDT.

attributes.name: isRegulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight is regulated and therefore received a CTOT from Network Operations.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: Current operational status of the flight as updated at each milestone.

operations.name: computeEIBT
operations.description: Computes EIBT using ELDT (or ALDT) plus the estimated taxi-in time (EXIT).

operations.name: computeTTOT
operations.description: Calculates TTOT as EIBT+MTTT+EXOT if later than EOBT+EXOT; overridden by TOBT+EXOT when TOBT is manually input.

operations.name: computeELDTFromATOT
operations.description: Calculates ELDT using the ATOT from the outstation and the Estimated Elapsed Time from the FPL.

operations.name: updateOperationalStatus
operations.description: Updates the flight's operational status as prescribed by the current milestone.

operations.name: exceedsTTOTTolerance
operations.description: Checks whether a proposed TTOT change exceeds the agreed TTOT tolerance, requiring Network Operations to be informed.

classes.name: ATCFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO flight plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by IFPS, used to check consistency and update flight data.

attributes.name: flightPlanId
attributes.description: Identifier of the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: submissionTime
attributes.description: Time the flight plan was submitted, normally 3 hours before EOBT.

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether the plan is a Repetitive Flight Plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights.

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: Estimated Off-Block Time contained in the flight plan.

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: Aircraft type as stated in the flight plan, which may update the flight's data.

operations.name: isConsistentWith
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry that the ATC Flight Plan must correspond to.

attributes.name: slotId
attributes.description: Identifier of the airport slot.

attributes.name: scheduledTime
attributes.description: Scheduled time associated with the slot, compared against SOBT/EOBT.

attributes.name: isCoordinatedAirport
attributes.description: Whether the airport is slot-coordinated, determining whether the outbound flight is already known.

classes.name: AircraftTurnRound
classes.definition: The turn-round of one aircraft comprising a related arriving and departing flight pair.

attributes.name: turnRoundId
attributes.description: Identifier of the turn-round.

attributes.name: minimumTurnRoundTime
attributes.description: Minimum turn-round time (MTTT) used in TTOT calculations.

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The central Airport Collaborative Decision Making system that is initiated for each flight, processes information and executes the milestone procedures.

operations.name: initiateFlight
operations.description: Initiates the Airport CDM Platform for a flight on activation of the ATC Flight Plan, processing all available information.

operations.name: processMilestone
operations.description: Executes the procedures and status updates defined for the given milestone against the flight.

operations.name: notifyPartners
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of an actual time or status change (e.g., ASBT, ARDT, ASRT, ASAT, AOBT).

classes.name: MilestoneProcess
classes.definition: One of the sixteen defined milestone procedures, each with a trigger, a consistency check, resulting operational status change and CDM actions.

attributes.name: milestoneNumber
attributes.description: Sequence number of the milestone (1-16).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the milestone, e.g. 'Take Off from Outstation'.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Event or timestamp that triggers this milestone process, e.g. 'EOBT-2hr' or 'ALDT detection'.

attributes.name: resultingStatus
attributes.description: Operational status the flight changes to upon this milestone.

operations.name: execute
operations.description: Performs the milestone's consistency check, updates flight estimates, changes operational status and notifies partners/Network Operations as prescribed.

classes.name: ConsistencyCheck
classes.definition: The recurring check that verifies the feasibility/consistency of the ATC Flight Plan, TOBT or TTOT at a given milestone before informing Network Operations.

attributes.name: toleranceValue
attributes.description: Locally agreed tolerance (e.g. TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes) within which no notification is required.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data, or between TOBT/TTOT and the ATC Flight Plan at the relevant milestone.

classes.name: DPIMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message sent to Network Operations to communicate updated take-off time estimates.

attributes.name: messageType
attributes.description: Type of DPI message, e.g. E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, A-DPI.

attributes.name: sentTime
attributes.description: Time the message was sent.

attributes.name: ttot
attributes.description: Updated Target Take Off Time carried by the message.

classes.name: FlightUpdateMessage
classes.definition: The FUM message sent by Network Operations via ETFMS providing updates on an inbound flight's progress and ELDT.

attributes.name: sentTime
attributes.description: Time the FUM was sent.

attributes.name: updatedELDT
attributes.description: Updated estimated landing time carried by the FUM.

classes.name: MovementMessage
classes.definition: The FSA and MVT messages generated on actual take off to inform all relevant Airport CDM Partners.

attributes.name: messageType
attributes.description: Type of movement message, e.g. FSA or MVT.

attributes.name: sentTime
attributes.description: Time the movement message was generated.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline operating the flight, responsible for submitting the flight plan and providing TOBT and other estimates.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Aircraft Operator.

operations.name: submitFlightPlan
operations.description: Submits the ICAO flight plan for distribution by IFPS.

operations.name: provideTOBT
operations.description: Provides or updates the Target Off-Block Time, taking into account the operational situation.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The ground handling agent that, together with the Aircraft Operator, manages the turn-round and provides estimates such as TOBT.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Ground Handler.

operations.name: provideTOBT
operations.description: Provides or updates the Target Off-Block Time based on the estimated turn-round period.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT, monitors flight progress via ETFMS and receives DPI/FUM messages.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the Network Operations function (e.g. NMOC).

operations.name: issueCTOT
operations.description: Issues a Calculated Take Off Time to a regulated flight at EOBT-2hr.

operations.name: receiveDPI
operations.description: Receives a DPI message informing it of an updated take off time estimate.

classes.name: ATCUnit
classes.definition: The Air Traffic Control unit (ACC, Approach, or Tower) responsible for radar detection, TSAT issue, and start-up approval.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name/identifier of the ATC unit.

operations.name: issueTSAT
operations.description: Issues the Target Start Up Approval Time based on the confirmed TOBT.

operations.name: approveStartUp
operations.description: Grants start-up/push-back approval (ASAT) to the flight.

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The Integrated Initial Flight Plan Processing System that distributes the ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: Distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units, including departure and destination aerodromes.

classes.name: RadarSystem
classes.definition: The ATC radar system that detects a flight by its assigned SSR code crossing FIR/TMA boundaries or entering Final Approach.

operations.name: detectFlight
operations.description: Detects the flight crossing the FIR/ATC boundary, entering the TMA, or entering Final Approach, or landing.

classes.name: ACARSSystem
classes.definition: The ACARS-equipped aircraft or automated docking/ATC systems that report actual times such as landing, in-block, off-block and take off.

operations.name: reportActualTime
operations.description: Reports an actual time (ALDT/AIBT/AOBT/ATOT) with +/-1 minute accuracy via ACARS ON/IN/OUT/OFF signals.

packages.name: Flight Management
packages.description: Core flight, flight plan, slot and turn-round data managed throughout the CDM process.

packages.name: CDM Process
packages.description: The Airport CDM Platform and the milestone/consistency-check procedures it executes.

packages.name: Messaging
packages.description: DPI, FUM and movement messages exchanged with Network Operations and CDM partners.

packages.name: External Actors
packages.description: External parties involved in the CDM process: Aircraft Operator, Ground Handler, ATC, Network Operations, IFPS.

packages.name: Sensing Systems
packages.description: Radar and ACARS/automated systems providing actual and detected time data.

unmodelled: Local parameter thresholds such as 't minutes before EOBT' for final TOBT confirmation, TSAT/ASRT/ASAT tolerance windows, and the count of allowed TOBT updates after TSAT are locally agreed values referenced but not modelled as separate classes (milestones 9,10,11,12,13,14).
Attachment 2's detailed DPI process implementation and Section 3.7.3's detailed CDM operation actions are referenced but their content is not described in the document (milestone 1).

The pre-departure sequence and arrival sequence into which flights are placed/refined/removed are mentioned as ATC constructs but no distinct class is warranted beyond the operational status changes already modelled (milestones 9,10,12,16).

The distinction between long-distance flights (ELDT differing from airport slot) and non-coordinated airports where the flight plan initiates the outbound flight are business rules without a clear owning class beyond Flight/AirportSlot (milestone 1).
